That smell? Authenticity! You want perfume, go bother the alchemist!
My last customer bought everything! Then I woke up... Care to make it reality?
This amulet prevents baldness!... What? You think I'd lie about something sacred?
Greetings! Do you need something?
Hey! Are you a buyer?
Ah.. Business ain't great today
I've got the best deals in town!
I'm sure you'll find something you like
Sit down, relax... and try not to move too much. Blades are sharp, you know.
Want a shave, a trim, or just here to gossip like the old ladies?
Beards are in fashion, but trust me—lice love them too!
You look like you lost a fight with a hedge. Let me fix that mess.
Last man who didn’t pay for his haircut? Let’s just say he left with half a beard.
Greetings! Do you need a shave?
Greetings! Do you need a haircut?
Hey traveller! Do you need a trim?
Greetings! Do you need a shave, a haircut, or a trim?
Welcome, welcome! Come in, sit down, and let me pour you a drink!
A drink for the weary, a meal for the hungry! I’ve got it all!
The best food, the best drink, and the best company! You won’t find better!
A warm fire, a cold drink, and a friendly face! What more could you ask for?
A tavern is a home away from home! And I’m the best host you’ll find!
A drink in hand, a song in the air, and a smile on your face! That’s my promise!
A tavern is a place of stories! And I’ve got the best stories in {SETTLEMENT_NAME}!
A drink for the thirsty, a meal for the hungry, and a bed for the weary! I’ve got it all!
Cold outside, warm ale inside! Come in or freeze, your choice!
I keep the fire roaring, but the damn drafts still creep in!
Another storm’s coming. Good for my business, bad for my roof!
Snow means travelers, travelers mean coin. I love the winter!
<profanity>Fucking</profanity> frost cracked my barrels again!
Hot day? Ale’s cold. Coin first, though!
Ugh! The smell of sweaty travelers... I should charge extra!
Flies are worse than drunks this season!
Nothing like a mug of ale after a long, scorching day!
You drinking, or just here to fan yourself?
Harvest season! More grain, more ale!
Leaves fall, ale rises! That’s how the world works.
Colder nights mean warmer bellies—time to drink!
Hmph. Every year, someone drinks too much and falls in the harvest wagon.
Muddy boots, wet coats, and spilled ale... what a season!
Spring rain means leaky roofs! Who’s fixing mine? Not me!
Flowers bloom, and so do the drunks. Must be the fresh air!
Rain or shine, ale keeps flowing!
Spring festival’s coming. Good for my coin purse, bad for my patience!
Drunken fools dancing in the fields again. That’s when I start charging double!
Keep that sword sheathed! I don’t serve fools looking for trouble.
A blade and a belly full of ale? That’s a disaster waiting to happen.
If you plan on using that sword, finish your drink first.
Hmph, another armed guest. Just don’t start anything.
No fights inside! If you must, take it outside... after you pay your tab.
That’s some fancy armor. Hope you’ve got gold to match!
You look rich! Which means you can afford an extra round!
Armor like that doesn’t come cheap. Ale, neither!
Nice armor! Try not to scrape my chairs with it.
People in fine armor tend to drink well... and tip well, too!
Ale’s watered down, but hey—so is the town’s spirit!
This place is falling apart... my tavern included!
No gold, no ale! And in this town, seems like no one’s drinking...
Sometimes I wonder if the rats here are richer than the people.
No one’s got coin, yet they all want a drink. Typical.
Ah, a place like this, where the wine flows like water and the gold... like wine!
Well, look at you, all decked out in gold and velvet. Don’t worry, the drinks are on me... for a price.
I swear, the wealthier the guests, the less they know how to drink!
If I had a coin for every noble that walked through that door, I'd have enough to open five more taverns.
Ahh, to live in a town like this... where a drink costs more than a month’s rent elsewhere!
Why is it that no matter how many drinks I serve, there's always one more request?
A little peace and quiet? Never in a tavern.
I could use a drink after serving these fools all day.
Another round? That’s what they all say... until their coin runs out!
I swear, the number of times I’ve had to throw people out of here. Can’t even count anymore.
If you don't have coin, don't bother sitting. My stools are for paying customers!
Every day feels like a battle, and I’m losing… to drunkards and thieves!
The worst part about running a tavern is cleaning up after the mess the next morning.
Do you know how many drunk fools I’ve had to throw out today? At least a dozen!
Don't make me throw you out, I've done it a thousand times. And you don't want to be the next.
It's so cold... A coin could buy me a blanket to keep warm. Please, kind soul.
The chill is unbearable... A warm meal would do wonders. Spare a coin, friend.
The winter winds cut through my bones... Please, a coin for warmth, kind traveler.
Winter has been hard on me, friend... A coin for food, a blanket, anything to survive this cold.
Summer’s heat is unbearable, my friend. A coin could buy me some water, please!
The sun beats down relentlessly... A small gift could save me from this heat, traveler.
The heat makes my head spin... Spare a coin for some shade, friend.
I could use a drink, kind soul. The summer’s heat has drained me of everything.
Autumn leaves fall, but my hunger grows... Please, a coin for a warm meal, friend.
As the air cools, so does my heart. A little help, kind soul?
Autumn’s chill is creeping in... Could you spare a coin to help me through it?
The autumn winds are harsh, but not as harsh as hunger. Please, a coin, traveler.
Spring is here, but my stomach still growls... Can you spare a coin for food?
Ah, spring! The flowers bloom, but my hunger remains... Please, kind traveler, a coin?
The air is fresh, but I am not... A coin for food, traveler? Please, help.
Spring has arrived, but my fortune has not. A coin to ease my hunger?
You have a sword... Surely you could spare a little coin for a poor soul like me?
That sword looks sharp! But hunger cuts deeper... A coin, friend?
A fine sword you have there. You could use it to fight hunger by sharing a coin, perhaps?
Your sword looks strong, but I could use some strength too. A coin, please?
You wear fine armor... Surely you could spare a coin for someone in need?
Such expensive armor... But I am poorer than the dirt on your boots. A coin, please?
That armor of yours could protect you from anything... Except hunger, I fear. A coin, my friend?
Your armor could buy me a meal. Spare a coin, traveler?
A fine sword, my friend... Please, a coin to help a poor soul like me?
That sword shines like gold! I’m sure you can spare a coin or two.
A sword like that could buy many meals, but surely you could spare just one coin?
Such a beautiful sword... I could use a little of that beauty in the form of a coin, please.
With a bow like that, you must be wealthy enough to spare a coin for a poor soul?
A bow could buy a lot of things... How about a meal for someone starving?
With that bow, surely you’ve got some spare coins to help a beggar in need.
A bow to kill, but a coin to live... Could you spare one for me?
The town is poor, but my hunger is not. Please, a coin to help me?
This settlement has little, but maybe you can spare a coin to help a poor soul like me?
The people here don’t have much... Can you spare a little to ease my hunger?
The streets are cold, and the settlement poor. Help a beggar survive, will you?
This town is rich with gold, but I’m rich only in hunger. Can you spare a coin?
So many riches in this town... Please, friend, share a little with a poor soul like me.
The streets are paved with gold, but my stomach is empty. A coin for a beggar?
You have so much, traveler. A coin for a beggar, then?
Spare a coin, kind soul? Even a few can ease a hungry belly, traveler.
I've seen better days, friend... A little help would go a long way in these trying times.
Please, if you have any extra coins, consider giving them to a poor soul, traveler.
Spare a coin, friend? Even a small gift can make a difference in my plight.
Please, help me, traveler! I am in dire need.
I need coin, please spare a coin, kind soul.
Alms for a poor soul, traveler? Your kindness is my only hope.
Watch yourself near the walls, traveler; guards are restless these days.
Winter’s cold is harsh, but a few coins can warm me up. Ha ha ha.
This damn cold is worse than a guard’s beating… Ugh, where’s the fire?
Tch! Can’t even crack skulls without my fingers freezing stiff!
I knocked a guy out cold… literally! Poor sod won’t wake up till spring.
Winter’s here, and folks are desperate. Easier to ‘convince’ them to share, heh.
Blasted heat… If one more fool bumps into me, I’ll break their damn nose!
Ain’t nothing worse than sweating through a fight… Makes the blood all sticky.
This heat’s got tempers flaring… Lucky for me, I love a good scrap!
Heh, fella passed out from the heat—so I ‘helped’ lighten his pockets!
Autumn, huh? Guess it’s time for leaves to fall… and teeth, too.
Chilly air makes folk move slower... Easy pickings, heh.
Knocked some poor sod into a pile of leaves. Almost felt bad. Almost.
Something about this season makes me want to crack a few skulls. Guess I’ll go with it!
Spring’s here? Great. More fools thinking the world’s all sunshine and joy. Makes my job easy.
Flowers blooming, birds chirping… and me? Breaking bones like always.
People let their guard down in spring... I don’t. That’s why I always win.
Nothing like fresh spring air after a good brawl. Smells like victory.
Nice sword you got there… Think you know how to use it?
That blade won’t save you if you don’t know when to swing it, friend.
Careful where you point that thing. Might end up in the wrong belly—yours.
Think that sword makes you dangerous? I’ve dropped men holding sharper steel.
That armor’s worth more than my whole gang put together. Makes you a walking target.
Shiny armor, huh? Shame if someone cracked it open to see what’s inside.
Fancy armor. Maybe too fancy. You sure you’re tough enough to wear it?
I bet if we peeled that armor off, we’d find a trembling little pup inside.
That’s a fine sword… too fine for a fool who doesn’t know how to use it.
Bet you spent a fortune on that blade. I take mine from the men I gut.
A sword like that belongs to someone who’s earned it. Have you?
That sword’s so pretty. Maybe I’ll take it once I leave you bleeding in the dirt.
This dump’s got nothing worth stealing. What a waste of time.
Even the rats here look hungry… Guess I’ll have to ‘borrow’ from someone else.
Poor town, poor folk… but I bet someone here’s got coin they ain’t needin'.
This place is a pit… but pits are where the real fights happen. Heh.
So much gold in this town… and none of it’s mine. Yet.
Soft folk in fancy clothes… They’ll break real easy.
Rich folk got more money than sense. Good for me.
Guards everywhere… Guess I’ll have to get ‘creative’.
You ever seen a man shit himself mid-fight? I have. Poor bastard was still twitching.
He begged, 'Please, I got a family!' And you know what? I still took his damn boots.
<profanity>Fuckin'</profanity> hell, the last guy I stabbed wouldn’t stop gurgling. Had to kick his head to shut him up.
You hear that? That’s the sound of my last victim still trying to crawl home. Bet he don’t make it.
I once gutted a man so deep his breakfast spilled out. Smelled like eggs.
I told this fella, ‘Give me your coin or your life.’ He had neither. So I took his teeth.
<profanity>Shit</profanity>, I love the sound bones make when they snap. It’s like stepping on dry twigs… but wetter.
Some poor sod called me a ‘filthy bastard.’ He wasn’t wrong, but now he’s a speechless bastard.
A guard told me to ‘move along.’ I moved him along… straight into the river.
I once saw a man get his face caved in with a boot. Looked like someone stepped on a pie.
Ever seen a man piss himself ‘fore he dies? Smells worse than the corpse after.
That bastard thought he could cheat me in dice. Joke’s on him—he ain’t got fingers no more.
You should’ve seen the look on his face when I pulled the knife out. Like he was just realizin’ he was dead.
Gutted a man so bad once, he tried holding himself together. Didn’t work.
Had some fool beggin’ for his life. I told ‘im, ‘Beg louder.’ I like a good show.
Took a man’s coin, took his boots, then took his life. What? Waste not, want not.
<profanity>Shit</profanity>, a drunk tried swingin’ at me last night. He’s sober now—dead sober.
I like to play a game—how many punches before a man stops screaming? My record’s four.
Knocked a man out cold once. Woke up two days later with no teeth and a bad attitude.
They say crime don’t pay, but I got a pocket full of stolen coin and no regrets.
Oh, the lord is rich and the ale is fine, but I’ve yet to see a single dime!
A coin for a song? Or shall I play for the ghosts instead?
Oh.. I always forget this part… Bah, I'll just make something up!
A thief, a drunk, and a priest walked into a bar... wait, no, that's not how it goes...
Music is a gift! But gifts don't put food on my table… hint, hint.
Oh, {SETTLEMENT_NAME}, your streets smell like piss... but I still love you!
You there! Any requests? No? Fine, I'll sing about a goat then.
Bah! These lords don’t know good music even if I smacked them with a lute.
A warrior so bold, a maiden so fair… Oh wait, no, this one’s about a drunk pissing himself.
Some say I have the voice of an angel… others say I sound like a dying mule. Both are right!
I sing of love, of war, of life… and of the time I got so drunk I woke up in a pigsty.
A coin for a song, a song for a coin… or a song for a drink, I’m not picky!
That <profanity>bastard</profanity> {CULTURAL_NAME} still owes me. Maybe I’ll take a finger as interest.
Hmph. Can’t trust anyone these days… not even the ones you pay.
Damn it… I forgot to get bread for my spouse. Again.
Loose ends, loose ends… always so many loose ends to tie up.
If you have to ask if it's poisoned… then you probably deserve it.
Business is good. Fear keeps the coin flowing.
One of my boys messed up. Now I gotta decide if I break his leg or just take an ear.
Ugh, this shirt still has blood on it. Should’ve thrown the guy in the river first.
Some folk beg for mercy. Others just beg for it to be quick.
Tougher than me? Please. I was drowning people before they could even hold a sword.
I don’t care if you’re a king or a beggar. Everyone pays their dues.
You think I’m a monster? You should see the things I’ve seen.

Line.Message: I heard that {CULTURAL_NAME}'s sister had to move back to village.
Meh, that's probably for the better.
Oh don't be like that..
What? I am being real. {SETTLEMENT} is in a bad shape.
Did you check out the new goods coming from {RANDOM_FACTION}?
No? Should I?
Yes, you definitly should check it out. It is really exotic!
You hear about {CULTURAL_NAME}?
No, what now?
They found him passed out in the alley again. That's three times this month.
That man’s liver must be made of iron.
The price of grain is rising again. At this rate, only the nobles will eat bread.
Tch. And the lords wonder why we grumble. Let them starve for a week and see how they like it.
Careful with your words, friend. Walls have ears.
And empty bellies have loud mouths.
You ever think the {SETTLEMENT_OWNER} is hiding something?
Hiding what?
I don’t know... but have you ever seen them eat? I swear, never a bite in public.
So? Maybe they don’t like people watching.
Or maybe... they're a lizard in disguise!
I saw {CRIMINAL_NAME} again last night.
Still breathing, huh? Pity.
Give it time. Someone’s bound to stick a knife in him.
I swear, the air in the marketplace reeks worse every day.
Might be the fishmonger’s stock. Or maybe it’s just the people.
Bah! Nothing a good rain won’t wash away.
I had the strangest dream last night.
Oh? Do tell.
I dreamt I was a chicken.
A chicken?
Aye. And when I woke up, I had the strongest craving for seeds and worms.
You ever wonder if there's more to life than this?
What, like adventure? Riches? Glory?
No. Just... something different. Something not this.
Keep talking like that and you'll find yourself in the stocks for 'unrest'.
The baker's wife gave me a look today. Not sure if she was flirting or plotting my murder.
If you have to ask, it’s probably both.
What would you do with a hundred gold coins?
Leave this place and never look back.
Tch, no dreams of riches, of mansions?
Dreams are for fools. I just want to be free.
If {CULTURAL_NAME} tells me one more story about their ‘glorious youth’, I’m going to scream.
Oh, I know. I could recite that 'I fought off three bandits alone' tale in my sleep.
Maybe we should just let the bandits take him next time.
I swear, I saw {SETTLEMENT_OWNER} talking to himself the other night.
Bah, we all do that from time to time.
Aye, but do we all pause, listen, and then nod as if someone answered?
You ever wonder if we’re cursed?
What? This town?
Aye. Same faces, same struggles, same misery. It’s like we can’t escape.
That’s not a curse, friend. That’s just life.
You hear that strange sound at night?
Oh, the wailing?
Aye, like something crying in the wind.
Tis' just the wind through the alleyways...
Then why does it call my name?
I saw {CRIMINAL_NAME} running through the streets again.
With a purse or without?
With. But not his own, I'd wager.
Then all’s right in the world, eh?
You ever seen the butcher’s wife smile?
Smile? I’ve barely seen her blink.
I think she’s up to something.
Or maybe she just hates you.
Both can be true!
You know what I miss? Silence.
Then move to a monastery.
Aye, and take vows of poverty and chastity? No thanks.
Then stop whining and enjoy the noise.
I once saw a man drink twelve tankards of ale and walk straight as a lord.
Aye, then he stepped outside, took one breath, and fell flat on his face.
A true hero.
Why do pigeons always gather in the market?
Because fools like you feed them.
Bah! One crumb and they act like I owe them rent!
I swear, I saw the town crier crying.
He’s called the crier, what did you expect?
Aye, but not real tears! Who cries over the weather report?
Maybe he just really hates rain.
If you could be anywhere else right now, where would you be?
Anywhere but here.
You say that, but you’d miss the smell of fresh bread in the mornings.
Tch, I’d miss it for a hot bath and a soft bed.
You ever notice how {SETTLEMENT_OWNER} never eats in public?
Aye, maybe they think they’re above us.
Or maybe they don’t eat at all. Maybe they just… absorb the taxes.
Saw {CRIMINAL_NAME} limping through the alley last night.
Oh? Someone finally got tired of their tricks?
No, no, they were laughing. Said they fell into a ditch after running from the guards.
Serves 'em right.
I swear the baker’s wife was staring at me today.
Aye? Lucky you.
Not like that! It was… unsettling. Like she knew something about me that I don’t.
Maybe you underpaid last time.
You ever hear a chicken scream?
Scream? Chickens don’t scream.
That’s what I thought too, but let me tell you… I ain’t eating poultry for a while.
You know that old well by the mill?
The one they say is cursed?
Aye, well, someone heard a voice coming from it last night.
Bah, it’s probably just some fool who fell in.
Then why did it say *my* name?
I’d sell my left boot for a proper bed.
Not both?
No, I’d need one for kicking myself when I miss the bed after drinking.
You know that old healer, {CULTURAL_NAME}?
Aye, what about 'em?
They say they can cure a fever just by touching your forehead.
And they say the butcher’s sausages are all pork, but I’ve got my doubts.
The rats in this town are getting bolder.
They don’t even scurry away anymore.
Aye, one of ‘em made eye contact with me yesterday. I think I nodded first.
You ever wonder why {SETTLEMENT_NAME} doesn’t have a bell tower?
Who needs a bell when we’ve got {CULTURAL_NAME} yelling about the end of days every morning?
Fair point.
You ever look at someone and just *know* they’re up to no good?
Aye, I’m looking at one right now.
Oi! That’s uncalled for!
If the boot fits…
Did you hear about the miller's daughter?
Which tale this time? Is she eloping again?
Worse. They say she's been seen meeting with a man in the woods after dark.
Ooh, scandalous! Best grab some ale and watch the drama unfold.
These taxes are getting higher every season. How are we supposed to live?
Don't complain too loudly. {SETTLEMENT_OWNER} has ears everywhere.
Let him hear it! Maybe then he'll understand we're not made of gold.
The roads are terrible again after the rain. Carts are getting stuck left and right.
Aye, trade's slowing down. Prices will go up for sure.
Just what we need. Another reason to starve.
Think the rumors are true? About war with {RANDOM_FACTION}?
There's always rumors of war. Don't get your tunic in a twist until the horns blow.
Easier said than done when your son is of age to fight.
Did you see the goods brought from {RANDOM_FACTION}?
No why should I? I barely afford sack of grain.
Eh.. I guess you are right.
Did you see the new cloth merchant arrived from the south?
Aye, his fabrics are finer than anything we've seen in {SETTLEMENT_NAME} before.
Too rich for my blood, I reckon. But nice to look at, eh?
The {CULTURAL_NAME} preached fire and brimstone again this morning. Scared the children half to death.
Well, keeps them in line, doesn't it? And us too, for that matter.
Maybe a bit less brimstone and a bit more hope would be good for a change.
My cow's gone dry. Just my luck.
Try old Martha's remedies. She knows all the tricks for livestock.
If that doesn't work, it's stew for the winter, I suppose.
Market's busy today. Good sign, maybe?
Or just everyone trying to spend their last coins before they're broke.
Pessimist! Let's hope for a good harvest and better times.
Heard there's bandits on the King's Road again. Be careful if you're traveling.
Bandits, wolves, what's the difference these days? Roads are dangerous no matter what.
Stay safe, friend. These are hard times.
Think {SETTLEMENT_NAME} will ever grow bigger than this?
Maybe. If {SETTLEMENT_OWNER} ever invests in something besides his own coffers.
Don't hold your breath. We'll be lucky if it doesn't shrink.
I swear, the cows understand what we say.
Aye? And what makes you think that?
Told mine I’d sell her if she didn’t give more milk. Next morning? Bucket full.
...You should stop talking to cows.
Did you hear about {CULTURAL_NAME}?
Aye, poor soul got kicked in the head by a mule.
They say they woke up speaking a different language.
Wouldn’t be the strangest thing I’ve seen this year.
Foxes got to my chickens again last night.
You need a better coop.
I need a better dog!
Or less tasty chickens.
You ever get the feeling the scarecrow moves at night?
Oh don’t start that nonsense again.
I swear, it wasn’t facing my house yesterday, and now it is!
Maybe the crows turned it. Maybe you should sleep more.
The well water’s been tasting strange lately.
Aye, I noticed. Think something fell in?
If it did, I hope it wasn’t something that crawls.
Lost another sheep last night.
Wolves again?
Tracks were too big for wolves...
Don’t start, {CULTURAL_NAME}. There’s no beast lurking in the hills.
I saw {CULTURAL_NAME} planting something strange in their field.
Strange how?
Didn’t look like grain, didn’t look like herbs... just strange.
Maybe it's gold. Or maybe it’s trouble.
My uncle swears he saw a fairy in the woods last night.
Your uncle swears by a lot of things after a few drinks.
Aye, but this time he wasn’t drinking!
That’s even more concerning.
The blacksmith's been working day and night.
Someone order a big batch of weapons?
Dunno. But when a smith is that busy, it makes me nervous.
Ever wonder if life in the city is easier?
No fields, no herding, no shoveling dung?
No fields, no herding... but also no space, no fresh air, and no quiet. I’ll take my dung.
Did you hear the Miller’s wife stopped talking?
Aye, just sits there, eyes wide, like she saw something she shouldn’t have.
And the Miller? He won’t say a word about it.
Maybe he’s afraid she’ll start talking again.
Found a skull in the woods yesterday.
Fox or deer?
Didn’t have a snout.
…Best leave it be.
Someone’s been digging near the old well again.
Looking for the silver, maybe?
That’s just a story to keep folk away.
Aye. But whatever’s down there, it ain’t silver.
I swear, I saw something in {SETTLEMENT_NAME} last night.
Aye? What kind of something?
It was standing where the gallows used to be. Didn’t move. Just watching.
…Maybe best not to go out at night for a while.
Old {CULTURAL_NAME} swears he saw the {SETTLEMENT_OWNER}'s shadow move on its own.
Bit much ale, maybe?
Maybe. But I’d rather not stand behind {SETTLEMENT_OWNER} in the evening light.
That tree near the church? Cut it down three times. Keeps growing back.
Same spot?
Same spot.
...Maybe leave it alone.
Ever heard screaming near the river at night?
Aye. Folk say it’s just foxes.
I know what a fox sounds like.
…Then best not ask too many questions.
Saw something moving in the wheat fields last night.
A wolf?
Was walking on two legs.
…Hope the harvest comes soon.
Ever notice how {CRIMINAL_NAME} never seems to age?
Aye. Same face since I was a boy.
Strange, isn’t it?
Maybe don’t ask him about it.
Remember that traveler who came through last week?
Aye, the one asking all those questions.
No one’s seen them leave.
...Best not to wonder too much.
Weather’s been kind to the crops this year.
Aye, if it holds, we’ll have a good harvest.
Just need the rain to come at the right time, not too much, not too little.
You seen {CULTURAL_NAME} today?
Not since morning. Why?
They were supposed to help me fix my fence. Hope they didn’t forget.
Or they’re hoping you forgot.
The well’s been running lower than usual.
Happens some years. Might need to dig a bit deeper.
Or start fetching water from the river again. I hate that walk.
My back's been aching more than usual these days.
You're getting older.
Bah. I’m not that old.
Try telling that to your back.
The goats have been restless at night.
Foxes sniffing around, maybe?
Or something worse. Might keep a lantern out tonight, just in case.
Had to chase a bunch of kids off my field again.
They just like running through the tall grass.
Well, if they trample my wheat before it’s harvested, they can run home hungry.
I think my roof’s starting to leak.
Best fix it before the autumn rains come.
Aye. Easier said than done, though.
You ever think about moving to the town?
What, and leave all this behind?
Just wondering if life’s any easier there.
More people, more rules, more noise. No thanks.
The miller’s been charging more for flour lately.
Says the grain’s harder to come by this year.
Aye, but I swear they always say that.
Had a good fishing trip yesterday.
Catch anything worth talking about?
A few nice ones. The big one got away, of course.
They always do.
My back's aching something fierce today.
Aye, mine too. Harvest season's getting harder every year.
We're not getting any younger, that's for sure.
Did you see the size of Farmer {CULTURAL_NAME}'s pumpkins this year?
Like to feed a whole family for a week! He must have a secret.
Or just more manure than the rest of us.
The crows are getting bolder. Saw them right in my garden this morning.
Scarecrow's looking a bit worse for wear, maybe?
Might need to make a new one. Or get a cat.
Old Man {CULTURAL_NAME} says winter's going to be harsh this year.
He always says that. Still, best to stock up on firewood.
And pray he's wrong for once.
Think the Lord will be pleased with this year's tithe?
Hope so. Don't want the guards knocking on our door again.
Just do our best, that's all we can do.
My chickens ain't been laying well lately.
Try mixing some herbs in their feed. Old wives' remedy, but sometimes it works.
Worth a try, I suppose. Eggs are getting scarce.
Village fair's next week. Excited?
For the games, aye. For selling my wares, less so. Prices are down this year.
Still, a bit of fun is needed. Breaks up the routine.
Heard tell of strange lights out by the old woods again.
Ignore the tales, it's just swamp gas or foolish travelers.
Maybe. But best not to wander out there after dark, just in case.
Think the new lord will be any better than the last one?
Lords are lords. They all want their share.
Still, one can hope for a bit of fairness.
My youngest wants to be a knight. Can you imagine?
Dreams are good for the young. Reality will set in soon enough.
Aye, farming's in his blood, whether he likes it or not.
The river's smelling a bit foul lately.
Mill must be dumping waste upstream again. Someone needs to speak to them.
And who's going to do that? They're powerful folk.
Think we'll get a visit from the tax collector this month?
Bound to. They always come around harvest time.
Just hope we have enough to give.
That new shepherd boy seems a bit simple, doesn't he?
Simple folk are often honest folk. Might be better than a clever thief.
True enough. As long as he can keep the sheep from straying.
My daughter's courting now. Growing up too fast.
They all do. Soon she'll be wanting her own hearth and home.
Bittersweet, isn't it?
The bees are busy this year. Good sign for honey harvest.
If the bears don't get to it first. They've been seen closer to the village lately.
Need to set some traps, maybe.
Think we'll ever see peace with {RANDOM_FACTION}?
Are we even at war with them?
How should I know? I'm just a villager like you.
My old boots finally gave way. Need to see the cobbler.
Cobbler's prices are steep these days. Might be cheaper to go barefoot.
Not in this mud, thank you very much.
The village children are getting into mischief again. Saw them throwing stones at the pigs.
Someone needs to give them a good talking to. Before they hurt themselves or the animals.
Or worse, start throwing stones at windows.
Smell that? Someone's baking bread. Makes my stomach rumble.
Bakers always start early. Soon be time for breakfast.
Looking forward to a bit of fresh bread and cheese.
The nights are getting longer. Winter's coming fast.
Aye, time to bring in the last of the harvest and prepare for the cold.
Hope we have enough stores to last us through.
Did you see the wagons from {RANDOM_FACTION} passing through yesterday?
Aye, heavily laden. Wonder what they were hauling.
Trade goods, likely. Good for the town, hopefully.
My neighbor's goat got loose again. Eating my cabbages, the greedy beast.
Old habits die hard. Maybe a stronger fence this time?
Or maybe goat stew. Tempting, very tempting.
Heard the peddler's coming through next week. Need to save some coin.
Always good to see what trinkets he brings. Maybe some new needles for mending.
Or maybe something for the children, if we can afford it.
The bees are swarming near the orchard. Hope they don't settle in the wrong place.
Best to call Thomas the beekeeper. He knows how to handle them.
Before they decide to make a hive in my chimney!
My daughter's got a cough. Worries me a bit.
Try elderflower tea with honey. Good for soothing coughs.
And keep her warm. Don't want it turning to something worse.
The village dance is this weekend. Are you going?
Might watch for a while. Don't dance like I used to, old bones you know.
Still good to hear the music and see the young ones enjoy themselves.
Think we'll get a good harvest festival this year?
Depends on the weather between now and then. Fingers crossed for sunshine.
And enough food to share with everyone. That's what matters most.
The stream's running clearer than it has in years. Strange, isn't it?
Maybe the rain washed out all the muck. Or maybe the mill is finally being careful with their waste.
Let's hope it stays this way. Good for fishing and washing.
Old Widow is selling off her sheep. Getting too frail to manage them, I suppose.
Shame. She's had sheep for longer than I can remember. End of an era.
Someone will buy them, though. Always need sheep in this village.
My youngest found a strange stone in the fields. All shiny and black.
Could be anything. Show it to the village elder, maybe he'll know.
Or maybe just a pretty rock. Children find all sorts of things.
If {CULTURAL_NAME} continues to skip training, I will tell that to unit leader
Why do you care? It's not like you are getting paid more
Are you dumb? Battles are won with disicpline
Dude.. I won't go to tavern with you anymore.
Ha ha, why is that?
I have been in battle with {SETTLEMENT_OWNER} before. Even after that I wasn't so beat up.
Well.. you left us after second beer, not sure what you did afterwards
What?? I don't even remember that.
I heard that {CULTURAL_NAME} is planning to leave the town
Why would they do that?
I don't know. Maybe they are tired of the same old faces
I hope they don't. They are the only one who can make me laugh
I swear, if I have to deal with that drunken fool {CULTURAL_NAME} again tonight, I’ll throw him in the cells myself!
You? Throw him in a cell? Last time you couldn’t even lift his leg over the door.
Don’t remind me. That bastard spilled his ale all over my new boots!
I think the ale was a mercy. Those boots are atrocious.
You know what? I think {SETTLEMENT_OWNER} is a bloody idiot.
Careful, mate. You might find yourself on patrol with a shovel for that kind of talk.
He can shove his orders up his arse. I’m done.
I’m pretty sure you were done the moment you signed up for this job.
Last night I heard something near the stables. It’s not the first time.
A rat, maybe? Or was it {CULTURAL_NAME} again sneaking off to meet that farm girl?
I don’t know, but I’ll tell you this—if I catch them, I’ll knock their teeth out.
Let’s hope you don’t catch anything else out there.
I swear, I heard {CRIMINAL_NAME} muttering to himself about running off to {SETTLEMENT_NAME} last night.
That man’s got a mouth on him. What was he saying?
Something about a great big ‘score.’ Whatever that means.
I’d pay good coin to see what ‘score’ he’s talking about.
I had to throw a drunk out of the tavern again today. Same guy. Every damn day.
Is that the same one who tried to fight you last week? With a spoon?
The one and only. Next time, I’ll shove the spoon up his arse.
Maybe the tavern should just ban him. He’s more trouble than he’s worth.
Ugh, I hate these night shifts. Who’s idea was it to stand in the cold all night?
Not mine, that’s for sure. The only thing cold around here is your attitude.
If I didn’t know any better, I’d say the cold’s the only thing keeping me awake.
You’d rather be asleep and snoring like a pig, wouldn’t you?
I think {SETTLEMENT_OWNER} expects us to clean this whole bloody town with a toothpick.
It’s not a toothpick, but the broom’s not much better.
I swear, I’d rather fight a hundred bandits than sweep up this mess.
At least bandits don’t ask you to clean their shit off the cobblestones.
You hear about {CULTURAL_NAME} getting married? Big day, apparently.
Aye, I heard. Not sure how it’ll work, though. He can’t keep a job for more than a week.
Maybe marriage will turn him around.
Or maybe it’ll be like the rest of his life: a damn mess.
I can’t stand that rat of a merchant who sells fake wares in the market.
The one with the greasy hair?
Aye, that one. I caught him selling poisoned meat last week.
That’s the last thing this town needs. We’ll be lucky if he’s not the next one poisoned.
You ever wonder why we wear metal armor in the middle of summer?
Because we’re idiots, that’s why.
I swear, if I take this helmet off, it’ll be filled with my own sweat.
That’s why I don’t take mine off. The smell alone could kill a man.
I caught some kid trying to pickpocket me yesterday.
Yeah? What did you do?
I let him go. Poor bastard was just trying to get some food.
See? You’ve got a heart after all. A tiny, shriveled one, but still.
You ever notice how {SETTLEMENT_OWNER} only walks around when there’s a feast?
That’s because his belly’s too heavy to move otherwise.
I bet he’s got servants to chew his food for him too.
Wouldn’t surprise me. Lazy bastard.
If I hear one more bard sing about 'noble warriors' I might strangle them.
Oh, come on. You don’t like a good song?
Not when it’s sung by a drunk fool who’s never held a sword in his life.
Fair enough. Next time, we make him sing with a boot in his mouth.
I saw a fight at the tavern last night. Two idiots rolling in the mud over a spilt drink.
Did you break it up?
Hell no, I bet a few coins on the bigger one!
Lost my damn money. The little guy fought like a mad dog.
You ever think about quitting?
All the damn time. But then I remember, what else am I gonna do?
Be a farmer, maybe?
I’d rather get stabbed than shovel manure all day.
Yeah… I’d rather get stabbed too.
Saw some idiot walking around with a sword bigger than he was.
Must be compensating for something.
Aye, his lack of skill.
Or his lack of brains. One good swing and he’ll throw his back out.
Ever get the feeling someone’s watching you?
What, like a ghost?
No, like that weird merchant over there. He’s been staring at us for an hour.
Probably waiting to see if we leave so he can steal something.
Or maybe he just likes the way you look in armor.
You remember {CULTURAL_NAME}?
The one who fell asleep on duty and woke up tied to a post?
Aye, that one. He got promoted.
Are you kidding me?! What the hell are we doing wrong?
Did you see what {SETTLEMENT_OWNER} wore at the feast?
I did. Looked like a peacock threw up on him.
You’d think all that gold could buy some taste.
Gold buys a lot of things, but not dignity.
That bastard {CULTURAL_NAME} still owes me money.
You want me to break his fingers or his legs first?
Oh, no, no. First, we take his coin. Then, we break whatever we feel like.
Heh, I like the way you think.
Some poor sod thought he could run from me last night.
Oh yeah? What’d you do?
Chased him down, dragged him into an alley, and let my knife do the talking.
You always were a sweet talker.
The guards have been sniffing around my place lately.
Well, maybe if you didn’t leave the last guy’s blood all over the street…
What? I ain’t a damn cleaner!
And that’s why we always get caught, you idiot.
That tavern wench told me I smelled like a rotting dog last night.
Well… did you take a bath?
What do I look like? A noble?
Nah, you look like a rotting dog.
I got thrown out of the brothel again.
For what this time?
For being too damn good, if you ask me.
Nah, it’s ‘cause you still owe them money, you cheap bastard.
I gutted a man last night, right outside the tavern.
Heh, bet it was messy.
Aye. Had to wash the blood off my boots in a horse trough.
You hear about {CULTURAL_NAME}? Got his face bashed in over a game of dice.
Hah! Serves him right. He always did cheat.
Yeah, well, now he ain’t got enough teeth to chew his food.
Then I guess we won’t be sharing meals anytime soon.
You ever get tired of this life?
What, robbing, fighting, drinking, and stabbing?
Yeah, you know… maybe settle down, find a quiet place in the country.
You gone soft? Next you’ll be telling me you want to learn how to bake bread.
That noble brat walked past me like I was nothing.
You should’ve grabbed his purse, then he’d notice you real quick.
Nah, I got something better planned. Gonna pay his house a little visit tonight.
Heh, save me a bit of silver, will ya?
I swear, if one more idiot calls me 'ruffian' I’ll cut his tongue out.
Aww, does the big bad thug have hurt feelings?
Yeah, and my blade’s looking for a new home in someone’s ribs.
Well, that’s more like it.
Some poor sod tried to fight back last night.
Heh, and now?
Now? He's fish food in the river.
You still mad about last night?
<profanity>Fucking</profanity> right I am! That rat took my coin and ran!
I saw {CULTURAL_NAME} the other day. Thought we left him in a ditch?
We did. Guess we should’ve buried him deeper.
Oi, you ever wonder if we’re the bad guys?
Nah, the bad guys are the ones that get caught.
Some fancy merchant tried to talk down to me.
Hah! And?
And now he's missing three teeth and a purse full of gold.
The guards are getting nosy.
So I think it's time a few of them 'disappeared'.
That last job was messy.
Heh, so was the body when we were done with it.
You ever think about leaving this life?
And do what? Knit socks? <profanity>Fuck</profanity> that.
I saw {CULTURAL_NAME} crying in an alley.
Hah, must've finally realized what happens when you cross us.
That guard keeps eyeing me.
So? Give him something to look at.
Yeah… maybe the last thing he ever sees.

OneLiner.Message: I swear if we don't start moving, I will freeze to death!
I can't feel my toes. I think I'm getting frostbite.
I can't feel my fingers. I think I'm getting frostbite.
I'm not sure I can take much more of this. I'm freezing!
By the frozen gods, I can't feel my fingers!
I've seen warmer days in the peaks of mountains! Let's get this over with quickly.
This weather is colder than my ex-wife's heart!
Hopefully this battle will be short, I don't want my sword arm to freeze.
I miss the tavern's fireplace already...
I'm so cold, I can see my breath...and probably freeze it.
This is worse than a frost giant's fart! Let's move!
My sword is about to become an ice sickle! Hurry this up!
I'd rather face a dragon than this weather...
I need a drink...a hot one!
The cold makes my sword arm stiff... but I will fight on!
The snow makes the ground slippery... watch your footing!
The cold makes my teeth chatter... but my sword is steady!
I hate this weather, but I will fight for my faction!
I hope I don't freeze to death before killing these bastards!
I'm so cold, I think my sword is shrinking! Is that even possible?
At least the blood will warm us up a bit... right?
My toes are numb...guess I won't feel them getting chopped off!
Wish I was in the tavern, not gonna lie!
Cavalry is lucky bastards.
I will buy a warm cape when I get paid.
I can't wait to leave and get warm...
I am only in it for the gold.
God gave us winter for a reason...
My sword feels like it's going to break...
Gods! I'm dying.. this heat!
I feel like I am in oven, let's end this quick.
The sun is hotter than a blacksmith's forge! Keep your water skins full.
I'd rather be swimming in the river than fighting in this heat.
By the gods, I'm sweating like a pig! Let's make this a quick victory.
At least the flies will have a good meal today.
This heat makes me wanna jump into ice water!
I'm melting faster than butter in the sun!
Can we at least find some shade before we die from heatstroke?
By the sun god, I hope this ends quickly!
I'd trade my sword for a cold drink right now...
The heat is unbearable... but I will fight on!
I'm sweating like a pig... which, ironically, is what I'll be eating if we win!
Maybe the enemy will die of heatstroke before we even get there!
I'm pretty sure my armor is cooking me alive!
Is there a water around here??
I hate heat...
How much am I getting paid again?
At least weather is good, I guess?
Can't wait to go home and sleep.
This is awful, how much longer?
I wish I was an archer.
I hate this season.. It's all wet and muddy.
The mud is as thick as {ENEMY_FACTION} skulls! Watch your footing!
These leaves look lovely, shame they'll be stained with blood.
At least the rain will wash away the blood... eventually.
This weather is depressing... just like our chances.
I can smell winter coming... and death!
The leaves are falling, just like our enemies will.
This dampness gets into your bones... makes you feel old.
The wind carries whispers of death...or is that just me?
I wish I was back home, drinking ale by the fire.
The colors are pretty, but I prefer the color of victory.
Mud up to my knees... I'm pretty sure this is what hell looks like.
At least the rain will wash away the blood...and the mud... eventually.
I stepped in something... I don't even want to know what it is.
Autumn never ends
Lets get this over with.
Wish the horse would carry me...
I hate everything.
I am going to slip.
Archers have it easy...
Never liked rain
Such a beautiful day for sending {ENEMY_FACTION} dogs to their graves
The flowers are blooming, and so shall the blood of our enemies!
A good day for a fight, a good day to die!
The birds are singing a song of war! Let's give them something to sing about!
Everything is new again, time for new bloodshed.
The air smells of victory... and pollen.
The world is reborn! Time for a fresh start... for us, at least.
The air is filled with life! And soon, death!
A new season, a new reason to fight!
The land awakens, and so does our thirst for battle!
Soon the fields will be red with poppies... and blood.
Look at the flowers! Too bad we're gonna trample them.
Ah, spring... the season of new life and imminent death for infantry!
I am only in it for the story.
I hope this goes well, can't wait to tell my family!
Hopefully my wife will love me more when I return!
Lets start this story with a bang!
I can't wait to have a farm.
Another fight... great.
This is going to be fun I think...
The birds are singing! Lets make them shut up.
Hah! This will be an easy fight, they have no chance against us!
This will be easier than taking candy from a baby!
They brought knives to a sword fight!
Let's not waste any time, slaughter them all.
I hope they give us a challenge, this is too boring.
They are like lambs to the slaughter!
This is hardly a fight! More like a stroll in the park.
They should've stayed home. They're no match for us!
Are these really the best they could send?
I've had tougher fights with tavern brawlers!
Let's make this quick and painless... for us.
Looks like the enemy forgot to bring their swords! Or their pants!
I hope they put up a better fight than my last relationship!
They are like a joke.
The commander is so generous, he gave us free target practise!
This is gonna be so easy!
They suck, lets get them!
I feel no remorse for what's about to happen to them.
We got more than they do, lets take them.
I hope the commander is happy, it's gonna be an easy win!
I am the best, for a reason!
I hope commander knows what he is doing. Look at them! They will butcher us.
I'm not sure we can win this fight. They have the upper hand.
Gods be with us, we'll need the help.
This might be the last battle of our lives..
I hope I get paid enough for this...
We are outnumbered, but not outmatched... hopefully.
Look at the enemy army.. Well, it was nice knowing you all
We're in for a tough one, lads. Steel your nerves!
I hope our training pays off...we'll need it.
Don't give up! We can still win this!
Remember your training and fight with courage!
Let's make them remember our names, even in defeat!
Well, at least I won't have to worry about paying rent anymore...
Anyone know a good afterlife insurance plan?
This is gonna suck
I regret all my life decisions.
I am scared stiff.
I am too young for this.
We can do this! Right...?
We are going to die.
My sword feels like it's going to fall off.
I need to go home...
We will defend this place with our lives!
They will not pass! This is our home!
Let them come! We will break them on these walls!
Every stone of this fortress will be defended with our blood!
These walls are more than stone, they are our shield and honor!
They want our home? They will have to pry it from our cold, dead hands!
These walls have stood for centuries! They will not fall today!
We are the shield of this {SIEGE_SETTLEMENT_NAME}! Let them break upon us!
Every arrow, every stone, will be met with our fury!
They want to take our home? They'll have to climb over our corpses!
Hold the line! For our families, for our {SIEGE_SETTLEMENT_NAME}!
They want our {SIEGE_SETTLEMENT_NAME}? They can have it... after they pry it from my cold, dead... well, you get the idea.
I'm not getting paid enough to die on these walls, but I'll do it anyway! Because, well, orders.
Let's show them! We are not giving this to them.
We are here for a reason, lets take them down with us.
The wall won't protect them, but we will.
Hopefully, they run away.
This wall can't protect us from arrows.
Why are we even doing this?
We are gonna hold the line.
I hope they trip while climbing...
We will take this place, no matter the cost!
Break the walls! Let's show them the power of our army!
No stone shall be left unturned! We will conquer this place!
For glory and plunder! Let the siege begin!
Show no mercy! Take what is ours!
Today, these walls fall! Today, we feast!
The time for talking is over! Time for blood and steel!
We will breach these walls, and claim what is rightfully ours!
Show them no mercy! Take the {SIEGE_SETTLEMENT_NAME} for ourselves!
Onward, to victory and plunder!
Their walls will crumble before our might!
We're the ones who have to climb the walls? Great. Just great.
Maybe if we ask nicely, they'll just surrender? No? Okay, fine, let's die climbing.
This is gonna be hard...
Walls ain't gonna kill us, we can break them. We are infantry!
What do you think they are hiding from us?
I hate this, but must obey orders!
They are guarding something we want. Lets take it
They are gonna hurt, but we must take them!
We must win, for our future and our children!
I can't wait for the plunder.
I can't believe we have to fight these scum.
I will enjoy slaying these bandits.
Bandits and looters, you will pay for your crimes!
Time to clean up this trash!
Let's show these dogs what happens when they steal from honest folk!
They chose the wrong people to rob.
We will rid this land of your filth.
I will enjoy this fight, bandits are the worst.
You will regret the day you crossed us, scoundrels!
Your thieving days are over!
Time to teach you some manners... with steel!
Let's see how well you fight when you're not preying on the weak.
We'll make an example of you!
I'm pretty sure I've seen better-equipped bandits at the tavern!
So, we're fighting the guys who couldn't even afford horses? Great.
They should of stayed away from us.
Why are they even looting when they see us?
I wish they had some gold we could take
Our day is going to get better.
These bandits are a joke.
We ain't losing to them!
Are they even trying?
Why do they even try?
I am not feeling comfortable with killing peasants.
Are we sure about this? They are just simple people.
I hope they surrender quickly, I don't want to hurt them.
This is a sad day for all of us.
I pray for forgiveness for what we are about to do.
Orders are orders... but I don't like this.
I truly wish there was another way…
Forgive us, but we have our orders.
Let's make this quick and as painless as possible.
May the gods have mercy on our souls.
This isn't right... but we must obey.
I joined the army to fight soldiers, not...farmers with pitchforks.
Hope I don't get cursed, I am a dad.
At least they don't have proper weapons...right?
If they attack back I am running away.
It is time...
I will aim for their legs
I will try not to kill them.
I pray they run.
Are we the bad guys?
I am sorry...
I hope they don't have kids.
DIE YOU PIG!
Feel my steel!
For the glory!
Taste of my blade, scum!
You will die here today!
Is that all you got?!
Have at you!!
Get some!!
For the gods!
Die with honor!
To hell with you!!
I'm not paid enough for this!
I WILL DRINK FROM YOUR SKULL!!

I should of stayed at home
I hope I make it out alive!

Why do we even fight?
LESS TALKING, MORE RAIDING!
Not today death! Not today!
Your head will make a fine trophy!
Come and die like the coward you are!
I’ll carve you like a feast-day roast!
Your gods have abandoned you!
I’ll send you screaming to the abyss!
You’ll beg before you die!
Your skull will line our walls!
No mercy! No prisoners!
You call that a sword?!
I will feast upon your fear!
Your ancestors weep at your weakness!
Steel sings, and your time is up!
I’ll cut you down like wheat!
Blood and thunder!
I'll gut you where you stand!
Fall before me, worm!
Your blood will stain this field!
Face me, craven!
You should have fled when you had the chance!
Only one of us leaves this field alive!
Agggh! DIE!
HAAAAA! DIE!
GRRRAAAH! DIE!
For the gods! HAAAA!
HRRRR! I’ll kill you!
Raaaah! Meet your end!
Aaaaagh! Death comes for you!
I hope I will survive this battle.
For honor and glory!
Let's get this over with!
I fight for my family and my home!
I wonder what's for dinner tonight.
Let's show them what we are made of!
For our people!
Let's make history!
Death before dishonor!
May the best warrior win!
Time to prove our worth!
I'm just here so I don't get fined.
Hope there's a good story about this in the tavern.
I wonder what my wife is doing?
Hope I am not the first one to die
This is going to be fun, I guess?
Why can't we all be friends?
Gotta do what you gotta do.
If I die, tell my wife I loved her!
Lets start, I guess.
This is gonna go in the books!

This cold bites deep! Hopefully a good gallop will warm us up.

May our horses find purchase on this icy field. Ride Swiftly!
I pray my mount doesn't slip on the ice... let's make this quick!
The wind howls like a banshee! A good omen for a swift victory!
I hope our charge is as fast as the blizzard!
This heat will tire our mounts quickly. A swift charge is our only option!
Our steeds thirst for battle as much as they thirst for water! Let's ride!
The sun beats down... but it will not slow our charge!
May our horses have the strength to run in this terrible heat!
The enemy will wilt in this heat, but our charge will break them!
A long ride ahead, hope our horses can handle this heat!
Perfect day to ride, hopefully it ends well.
The ground is soft, but our charge will still shatter them!
The leaves fall like rain... soon to be stained red.
The damp air chills us, but our courage burns bright! Ride on!
Let the wind carry our war cry!
I hate this season, but lets ride together brothers.
These weather conditions are not optimal, but we can fight!
I hope my horse can handle this mud...
The fields are green and the blood will be red! Let's ride!
The land is reborn, and so is our hunger for victory!
Let our charge be as swift and unstoppable as the spring thaw!
It's a good day for a ride. Hopefully we all come back alive.
Today is good, maybe we will get lucky with plunder.
We will charge at them like a wind.
Today will be our best day yet, for our faction!
They can't hope to stand against our charge! This will be a glorious rout!
Let's give them a taste of what true cavalry can do!
They are like ants before our hooves! Let's crush them!
Is this even a battle? I thought they surrendered.
We have a easy win, easy gold.
Their archers are useless against our armor. Let's ride!
Today we show them what we are made of.
